description_en: Server-side API for the international Face Guard service
description_zh: 国际人脸保镖纯服务端接口
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl face-guard-risk --device-token Tk9SSUQuMS00000000000000000ZDNmNWY5NzQxOW1o --merchant-biz-id 0c83ce0101d34eff886b1f7d1cdef67f --product-code FACE_GUARD --biz-id LMALL20000000001 --type example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: FaceGuardRisk

parameters.help_en: The device token obtained from the Face Guard SDK
parameters.name: device_token

parameters.help_en: The merchant-defined unique business identifier, used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can contain letters and digits with a maximum length of 32 characters. Make sure the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The product code. Set the value to FACE_GUARD
parameters.name: product_code

GuardRiskScore.description_en:
The device risk probability predicted by the Face Guard algorithm. A higher score indicates a higher device risk.

Value range: 0 to 100
GuardRiskScore.description_zh:
人脸保镖算法预测的设备风险可能性，分数越高代表设备风险越高。

分值取值：0~100

RiskExtends.description_en: The extended information in JSON format. The response is customized based on tenant requirements
RiskExtends.description_zh: 拓展信息，JSON格式。（按租户需求定制返回）

RiskTags.description_en:
The device risk tags.

Multiple device risk tags are separated by commas (,), such as "ROOT,VPN,HOOK".

For more information about device risk tags and their meanings, refer to the Face Guard tag description in the official documentation
RiskTags.description_zh:
设备风险标签。

多个设备风险标签以半角逗号（,）分隔，如“ROOT,VPN,HOOK”，

如需了解更多设备风险标签及其含义，请参见官方文档人脸保镖标签说明

TransactionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the authentication request
